# Heavy / on-demand (install via the helpers in 00_setup or per-tool docs; pin what you actually use):
# --- Scaffolding (the A100-bound step) ---
# RFdiffusion        # classic motif scaffolding (free-tier DEMO): https://github.com/RosettaCommons/RFdiffusion ; pin the commit
# RFdiffusion2       # all-atom motif scaffolding (Dauparas 2025) — VERIFY current public release/repo at generation time
# Riff-Diff          # theozyme→enzyme scaffolding (Schnettler 2025, Nature) — VERIFY current public release/repo at generation time
# --- Sequence design (CPU-fast) ---
# LigandMPNN         # ligand/TS-aware, fixes the catalytic triad + oxyanion hole: https://github.com/dauparas/LigandMPNN ; pin the version
# --- Structure prediction (catalytic-residue geometry) ---
# colabfold          # AF2 — prefer the official ColabFold notebook; pin the commit. (ESMFold via transformers for fast triage.)
# transformers>=4.40 # ESMFold triage (EsmForProteinFolding)
# --- Thermostability MD (THIS PROJECT'S EMPHASIS) + docking ---
# openmm             # thermostability MD (RMSF + melting-proxy): https://github.com/openmm/openmm ; pin the version
# pdbfixer           # structure prep for OpenMM
# mdtraj             # trajectory analysis (RMSF, native-contact / RMSD melting-proxy)
# (GROMACS is a valid alternative MD engine for the thermostability runs — pin the version you use.)
# (AutoDock) vina    # PET-mimic ester pocket fit: https://github.com/ccsb-scripps/AutoDock-Vina ; pin the version
#
# COMPUTE REALITY (see MANUAL.md §2 + MASTER_BLUEPRINT §3): scaffolding 1000s of backbones with
# RFdiffusion2/Riff-Diff wants an A100 (Colab Pro+ or HPC). LigandMPNN is CPU-fast; ESMFold/AF2
# triage runs on a free T4. The THERMOSTABILITY-MD ranking is the second compute load: short triage
